projectDescription: Mission Control is Joe's live operational system for MyOS, a self-hosted personal AI OS. It runs as a Next.js dashboard serving as a command center for managing business, research, and productivity workflows, orchestrating agents, tools, and automations. This is the Golden Claw testing build with sanitized personal data and real API keys.

directoryStructure.mission-control: Main Next.js application (port 3000/3001) - primary UI and API layer
directoryStructure.mission-control/app: Next.js app directory with pages, API routes, and layouts
directoryStructure.agents/task-runner: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces for task execution and scheduling

languageNotes.TypeScript: Core language for type-safe development. All components and utilities use strict TS with strict mode enabled.
languageNotes.JavaScript: Used in config files (next.config.js, seed scripts) and legacy compatibility
languageNotes.React: 19.0.0 RC version - modern React with hooks, functional components, concurrent features
languageNotes.Tailwind: Dark theme implementation with custom tokens (cm-purple, dark-panel, etc.) - no hardcoded hex colors
languageNotes.Next.js: 15.1.0 - Turbo mode enabled for faster HMR. API routes at app/api/, server components where applicable

languageLesson: This is a mature Next.js monorepo combining a unified dashboard (mission-control/) with decoupled background agents (agents/task-runner/) using pnpm workspaces. The mission-control frontend enforces strict styling rules (dark theme, token-based colors) and maintains a dedicated CLAUDE.md with page checklists, color tokens, and icon sourcing rules. TypeScript is non-negotiable; the project uses @types packages for all external libraries. CSS is pure Tailwind - no custom stylesheets except minimal utility classes.
notes: Mission Control is Joe's live operational system at port 3000 in ~/.myos/workspace/. Golden Claw (this repo) is a sanitized testing build with real API keys. Development uses 'next dev --turbo' for hot reload. Task runner is a pnpm monorepo (agents/task-runner/) with packages for database access, shared utilities, and adapters. All 1210 source files identified; 1000 most significant files listed. Build enforces 3GB Node heap. See mission-control/.claude/CLAUDE.md for page creation checklist, color token rules, icon sourcing (bundled lucide-react only, no CDN), and scroll position safety rules.
